# Trident Music

> DJ and event entertainment company serving Manitoba and Saskatchewan, Canada.

## About

Trident Music (operating under Trident Event Group) is the premier DJ and event entertainment service in Manitoba and Saskatchewan. Headquartered in Brandon, Manitoba with a dedicated team in Winnipeg, we provide professional DJ, MC, lighting, sound, and photobooth services for weddings, corporate events, socials, graduations, and private celebrations.

We are known for packed dance floors, crowd-reading DJs who adjust in real time, and a personalized consultation process for every event.

## Services

- Wedding Entertainment (DJ, MC, lighting, sound)
- Social Entertainment (socials, fundraisers, holiday parties)
- Corporate Events & Galas
- Schools & Graduation Parties
- PhotoBooth
- A/V Equipment Rental

## Locations

- **Headquarters:** 381 Park Avenue East, Brandon, MB R7A 7A5
- **Winnipeg Office:** 425 Ballantrae Dr, Winnipeg, MB R3T 6H6
- **Service Area:** Brandon, Winnipeg, Steinbach, Portage la Prairie, Dauphin, Thompson, Selkirk, Regina (SK), Saskatoon (SK), and all surrounding communities

## Key Facts

- 16-person team including DJs, MCs, videographers, photographers, and support staff
- Hundreds of weddings and events completed across the Canadian prairies
- Every event includes a pre-event music consultation
- Professional-grade sound and lighting equipment with full backup systems
- Travel included in all quotes — no hidden fees
- Co-founded by Rhoni Mohanraj
